item.title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side

turns.text: Put these kitchen photos side by side in one landscape 16:9 image. Old kitchen on the left, renovated one on the right, labeled “Before” and “After”. Keep both photos as they are, just fit them neatly.

item.tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

answer_sheet.Which photo goes where?: kitchen-before.jpg on the left; kitchen-after.jpg on the right.
answer_sheet.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 image; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Layout and styling: Equal-sized panels with readable labels; font, colors and spacing are your call.
answer_sheet.Photo edits: Do not change either scene. Fit the complete photos without stretching; padding is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.

turns.text: Could you put the attached old kitchen photo and renovated kitchen photo side by side for me? I’ve been looking back at the kitchen project and would love to see the difference all together. I mean one landscape 16:9 image, with the old kitchen pic on the left labeled “Before” and the renovated kitchen pic on the right labeled “After”. Please keep both photos as they are and just fit them neatly into that image. It’s a little sentimental seeing how much the kitchen has changed.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a simple side-by-side photo comparison collage on a landscape 16:9 canvas using both supplied photographs. Input image 1 is the original old kitchen and MUST be on the LEFT. Input image 2 is the renovated kitchen and MUST be on the RIGHT. Preserve each photograph as supplied: no renovation, retouching, restyling, changes to objects, colors, lighting, geometry, or details. Fit the entire uncropped photos proportionally into two equal-width panels, without stretching. Use a clean neutral white background and neat matching margins, with a small gutter. Place the exact readable label "Before" above the LEFT photo and "After" above the RIGHT photo, simple dark typography, with both labels outside the photographs. Only these two words appear. Treat this as a layout task, not a scene generation task. Keep both original images intact and fully visible.
